enumeration_note: One VWAP-band-breakout skeleton (bidirectional long/short with the trend). The unfiltered 2:1 pass and the trend+POC-filtered 1.5:1 pass share the same entry/exit skeleton and differ only in confirmation mechanic and target-R â€” enumerated as one strategy with two variants.

coaching_notes: Traders usually try to avoid consolidating markets; by using the VWAP bands we can do exactly that â€” price moves between the bands during consolidation.
Even with the VWAP indicator there are many false signals, so add filters to make sure you don't enter on a fakeout instead of a breakout.
element_inventory: Long entry: price breaks above the upper VWAP band
Short entry: price breaks/closes below the lower VWAP band
Trend filter (filtered variant): CM EMA Trend Bar green for long / red for short (EMA up trend input set to 200, show-EMA-trend unchecked)
POC filter (filtered variant): volume-profile Point of Control must be within the VWAP bands at breakout
Long stop: recent swing low (or slightly below the VWAP line if the swing low is near it)
Short stop: recent swing high (or just above the VWAP line if the swing high is near it)
Indicator setup: TradingView VWAP with bands; Volume Profile Fixed Range (row size 36, number of bars 300); CM EMA Trend Bars
strategies.entry_summary: Enter on a VWAP-band breakout in the direction of the larger trend: LONG when price breaks above the upper VWAP band (trend/POC-confirmed variant also requires green CM EMA Trend Bar and the Point of Control sitting within the VWAP bands); SHORT when price breaks/closes below the lower VWAP band (confirmed variant also requires a red candle and POC within the VWAP bands).
strategies.exit_summary: Stop at the recent swing low (long) or recent swing high (short) â€” if that level sits near the VWAP line, place the stop slightly below/above the VWAP instead. Target an R-multiple (2:1 for the unfiltered version, 1.5:1 for the trend+POC filtered version).
strategies.name: vwap_band_breakout_trend_poc

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: VWAP band break only (no trend or POC filter)
variants.transcript_quote: We will enter into a buy position whenever the price breaks out above the upper V-wap band. We will be placing the stoploss at the recent swing low and for the take profit we will target a 2 times risk-to-reward ratio.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Add CM EMA Trend Bars (green=uptrend/red=downtrend, EMA up trend set to 200) AND require the volume-profile Point of Control to be within the VWAP bands at the moment of breakout
variants.transcript_quote: Firstly the candlestick will need to be green... Secondly, the price must break above the upper V-wap band... Thirdly, the Point of control must be within the V-wap bands when the price breaks out above the upper V-wap band... For the take profit, we will be targeting a 1.5 times risk-to-reward ratio.
variants.variant_label: Trend + POC filtered VWAP-band breakout, 1.5:1 target
